description: This PHP class 'EducationService' provides methods for managing education entities within the OrangeHRM system, including CRUD operations, searching, and validation related to education records.

classes.name: EducationService
classes.description: Service class for managing Education entities, providing CRUD operations, search, and validation functionalities.

methods.name: saveEducation
methods.description: Saves an Education object, either creating a new record or updating an existing one.

methods.name: getEducationDao
methods.description: Retrieves the EducationDao instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getEducationById
methods.description: Retrieves an Education object by its ID.

methods.name: getEducationByName
methods.description: Retrieves an Education object by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getEducationList
methods.description: Returns a list of Education objects based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEducationCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Education records matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteEducations
methods.description: Deletes multiple Education records by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingEducationName
methods.description: Checks if an Education name already exists, case-insensitive.
